title: Mortality and life expectancy
description: How long people live, how long they live in good health, what people die from, and where.

title: Cancer
description: New cancer cases, screening, diagnosis and deaths, by cancer site.

title: Heart and kidney disease
description: Heart conditions, high blood pressure and cholesterol, stroke and kidney disease (cardiovascular and renal conditions).

title: Diabetes
description: Diabetes prevalence and risk, care and treatment, and complications.

title: Mental health and wellbeing
description: Mental health conditions, wellbeing, self-harm and suicide, and mental health services.

title: Brain and neurological conditions
description: Dementia, epilepsy and other conditions affecting the brain and nervous system.

title: Breathing and respiratory disease
description: Asthma, COPD, pneumonia and other conditions affecting breathing.

title: Liver disease
description: Liver disease, including disease linked to alcohol and fatty liver.

title: Muscles, bones and joints
description: Back pain, arthritis, osteoporosis and fractures (musculoskeletal conditions).

title: Sight and hearing
description: Sight loss, eye care and hearing (sensory health).

title: Dental and oral health
description: Tooth decay, oral health and dental services.

title: Stopping the spread of infection
description: How infections are prevented, detected and controlled, including vaccination, healthcare-associated infections and antibiotic resistance (health protection).

title: Sexual and reproductive health
description: Sexually transmitted infections, HIV, contraception, abortion and teenage pregnancy.

title: Pregnancy and early years
description: Pregnancy and birth, babies' health, infant feeding and early child development.

title: Injuries
description: Falls, road traffic injuries and injuries to children and young people.

title: Health behaviours
description: Everyday behaviours that affect health, such as smoking, alcohol, drugs, diet, physical activity and weight.

title: What shapes our health
description: The wider conditions in people's lives, such as income, housing, education, work and the local environment (the wider determinants of health).

title: Fairness in health and vulnerable groups
description: Differences in health between areas and groups, and the health of groups at greater risk of poor health.

title: Using health and care services
description: How people use hospital, A&E, GP and social care services, and their experience of care.
